underwater_swarm package

Submodules

underwater_swarm.config module

Configuration parameters for the Underwater Drone Swarm Simulation.

This module contains all the constants and configuration settings used throughout the simulation, including physics parameters, drone specifications, swarm behavior weights, and environment bounds.

class underwater_swarm.config.SwarmMode(value)[source]

Bases: Enum

Defines the operational modes for the drone swarm.

PATROL

Standard patrolling behavior.

ATTACK

Aggressive behavior towards a target.

DEFEND

Defensive formation.

ENCIRCLE

Surrounding a target.

SHIELD

Protective formation.

SEARCH

Search pattern behavior.

FLASH_EXPANSION

Rapid dispersal behavior (biomimetic).

SCHOOLING

Tight formation, high alignment (Biomimetic).

PREDATOR_PACK

Coordinated hunting (Biomimetic).

EXPLORATION

Wide area search (Biomimetic).

ATTACK = 'ATTACK'
DEFEND = 'DEFEND'

underwater_swarm.drone module

Defines the Drone agent class.

This module contains the Drone class, which represents an individual agent in the swarm simulation. It handles physics integration, force application, and state management for various behaviors.

apply_drag(fluid_velocity)[source]

Applies hydrodynamic drag force based on relative velocity.

Calculates drag using a simplified quadratic drag equation: F_d = -0.5 * rho * Cd * A * v^2 * unit_vector(v)

Parameters:

fluid_velocity (np.ndarray) – Velocity vector of the surrounding fluid.

apply_force(force)[source]

Applies a force vector to the drone.

Parameters:

force (np.ndarray) – 3D force vector to apply.

calculate_forces(neighbors, environment, targets, friends, mode)[source]

Calculates the net force based on local perception and current mode.

Parameters:

  • neighbors (list[Drone]) – List of nearby drones.

  • environment (Environment) – The simulation environment.

  • targets (list[np.ndarray]) – List of enemy/target positions.

  • friends (list[np.ndarray]) – List of friendly unit positions.

  • mode (SwarmMode) – Current behavior mode.

update(dt)[source]

Updates the drone’s physics state using Euler integration.

Calculates the new velocity and position based on accumulated forces (acceleration), applies speed limits, and resets the acceleration accumulator for the next step.

Parameters:

dt (float) – Time step in seconds.

underwater_swarm.simulation module

Manages the main simulation loop.

This module orchestrates the simulation, including initialization of drones, environment, and the swarm controller, as well as the main time-stepping loop.

step()[source]

Advances the simulation by one time step.

Updates target positions (if wandering), applies swarm logic via the controller, and integrates physics for all drones.

underwater_swarm.swarm module

Implements the swarm intelligence logic.

This module contains the SwarmController which now acts as the high-level coordinator (Swarm Layer). It delegates the local force calculations to each Drone agent (Local Layer) while managing global states and mode transitions.

class underwater_swarm.swarm.SwarmController[source]

Bases: object

Manages the swarm behavior by coordinating individual drones.

update(drones, environment, targets, friends, mode=SwarmMode.PATROL)[source]

Updates all drones in the swarm.

Iterates through each drone and triggers its local force calculation logic.

Parameters:

  • drones (list[Drone]) – List of drones to update.

  • environment (Environment) – The simulation environment.

  • targets (list[np.ndarray]) – List of enemy/target positions.

  • friends (list[np.ndarray]) – List of friendly unit positions.

  • mode (SwarmMode, optional) – Current behavior mode. Defaults to PATROL.

underwater_swarm.viz module

Visualization tools for the swarm simulation.

This module handles the 3D visualization of the simulation using Matplotlib. It includes a live interactive visualizer (LiveVisualizer) and a legacy static animator (animate_swarm).
